responses.q: How is gratuity calculated?
responses.answer: Gratuity equals fifteen days of your last drawn Basic Salary for each completed year of service. Calculate it as (Basic Salary × 15 ÷ 26) × (number of completed years). Any part‑year exceeding six months counts as a full year. The amount is capped at Rs 20,00,000 as per the Payment of Gratuity Act. [S1][S2]

responses.q: I am an L2. Can I encash my earned leave this year?
responses.answer: You cannot encash earned leave while you are in Grade L2; encashment during service is only available to Grades L3 to L8 [S1][S4][S2].
